text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following a nice day out, Symboli<n>Rudolf and I
return to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for asking, but are you<n>busy right
now?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hoped we might speak a little longer.<n>Over coffee,
perhaps?
choice_data_list: Should we head over to my office?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That sounds perfect. Lead the—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez! There you are! I've been<n>looking all over for
you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I pulled off the craziest winyesterday! I've gotta tell you all aboutit!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Dear me. No rest for the wicked, it<n>seems...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove and Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: President! Hey, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for springing this on you<n>so suddenly,
but the student council<n>has received a request
from the<n>director—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, you don't! We've got asituation over at the dorms, and Ineed the Prez's help pronto!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can handle that myself later. The<n>director's
request is far more urgent—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, back off, you two! I had her first!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You just want a chance to brag! This<n>is urgent!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, a fight seems about<n>to break out
over Symboli Rudolf's<n>attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, what to do?
choice_data_list: Let's take a rain check on that coffee.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It doesn't seem meant to be today,<n>does it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But today will be far from our only<n>chance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, you three, please settle down<n>and wait your
turn. I'll hear you all out<n>in a more appropriate
location.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The others quickly fall in line as<n>Symboli Rudolf
takes charge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Goodbye, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Rudolf walks away with<n>the rest of the
group in tow, it's hard<n>not to admire the respect
she<n>commands from her peers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no need. This is all just<n>part of the job
of student council<n>president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, today will be far from our<n>only chance to
speak more. We'll<n>just have to have our coffee
together<n>some other time.

text_block_list.text:

turn. I'll hear you all out<n>in a more appropriate
location.

Watching Symboli Rudolf quickly get<n>the other
three in line, I feel like I've<n>caught a glimpse of her
Emperor side.
